findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 2 section(s) have content at both edges and 836px of nothing between: "Wil delivered an energised and engaging presentati"; "Send the brief. You will hear back within one busi"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1880px at 11064px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Organisers say"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 768px: "I'm Wil Massara, a Gen Z keynote speaker…" → 4 lines at 29.1px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Organisers say" (screen 9, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "lead now." (screen 2, 66% over a picture); "Young people" (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
